Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: Ilwww.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 25 s. 2023 MAR 3) 2023 Mr. DOMINADOR M. GARCIA Dmgl 104@yahoo.com 33 Our Lady of Miraculous Medal Street Brgy. Rosario, San Pedro Laguna Dear Mr. Garcia: This refers to your letter dated December 19, 2022, regarding the budget share of Senior Citizen Association from the local government units. As represented in your letter, you are one of the active members of Rosario Complex San Pedro Senior Citizen Association, Inc. (RCSPSCAI), which is also registered with the Securities Exchange Commission. In view thereof, two queries are proffered for this Department's opinion, thus: I. Whether] the Senior Citizen Association members are qualified for 1% allocation of the LGU's Intemal Revenue Allocation for programs, projects, maintenance, medicine, and activities of the elderly and persons with disabilities; and 2. Do the officers/members of senior citizens prepare a resolution requesting the release of the said fund or how to avail of the 1% allocation? In reply thereto, we deemed it apt to answer the foregoing queries in one discussion as they are both interrelated. As it stands, there is no national law that specifically mandates the local government units (LGUs) to allocate one percent (1%) of their respective National Tax Allotment—previously called the Internal Revenue Allotment— for senior citizens. There is, however, a legislative measure being proposed in the Lower Housel that seeks the allocation of one percent of LGUs' NTA for senior citizens. Being a proposed legislative measure, the same cannot be implemented yet. While this Department has issued Memorandum Circular No. 2014-59, dated May 9, 2014, which encourages the allocation of 1% for the implementation of programs, projects, and activities for senior citizens. In particular, Item 2 of the aforesaid MC provides that: 1 House Bill No. 3641 , "AN ACT MANDATING LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS TO ALLOCATE ONE PERCENT (1%) OF THEIR INTERNAL REVENUE ALLOTMENT (IRA) FOR PROGRAMS AND PROJECTS FOR SENIOR CITIZENS AND 1% OF IRA FOR PROGRAMS AND PROJECTS FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES" Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

"xxx [A]ll Local Chief Executives are hereby encouraged to: 1. Xxx 2. Allocate 1% of their respective budget pursuant to DBM-DSWD Circular No. 2003-01 dated April 28, 2003 re: Implementing Guidelines for Section 29 of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) for FY 2003 entitled Setting Aside One Percent of Government Agency Budget for Programs/Projects Related to Senior Citizens and Disabled." (Emphasis supplied), the said guidelines can no longer be used as basis for the 1% allocation as the same was issued to implement Section 29 of the GAA for FY 2003. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, y the uthority of the Secretary: R R. LLAMAS Y. JUAN I Un rsecreta for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs O ELI-NJVULLLS-LRALLD/jam/rrao
